description: Pins INSIDE the certspotter image (infra-ik4p.11): the certspotter module, the golang.org/x floors the Dockerfile raises over its go.mod, tini, and the golang and debian bases. None of them moved without a CVE before (CERTSPOTTER_VERSION sat at 0.25.0 behind upstream). Runs from mdapi/fleet's `renovate` job, which lists this repo in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES; Windmill f/probe/renovate_pin_coverage flags any pin no reader sees. The readers (Dockerfile FROM + the `# renovate:` ARG regex), the house core, OSV alerts, the dependency-proxy alias and the SHA re-pin by mdapi/fleet's installed tools/repin_sha256.py come from the shared preset local>mdapi/renovate-config:image-repo; do not set enabledManagers or postUpgradeTasks here, since a repo value REPLACES the preset's. MR-only baseline: a merge here pushes :latest, which mdapi/fleet's digest MR rolls out, so nothing automerges until a graduation tick says so.
prBodyNotes: Tick one box to change what automerges for this dependency **from now on**. Windmill `f/desk/renovate_graduate` reads the ticks and labels on this repo's Renovate MRs and opens an MR against its `renovate.json`; nothing changes until that MR merges. The label is the durable form — `automerge:digest`, `automerge:minor`, `automerge:major`, `automerge:never` — and works on a merged MR too.
- [ ] <!--grad:{{{packageName}}}:digest--> automerge future **rebuilds of this tag** — digest: same version, new content  ·  label `automerge:digest`

⚠️ `digest` is deliberately NOT implied by the version ticks: on a pinned tag (`debian:13`) a digest is that release rebuilt, the base-image fix path. A merge here builds and pushes `:latest`, and mdapi/fleet's digest MR for certspotter/certspotter-deploy.yml deploys it.

packageRules.description: The golang.org/x modules are a synchronized train: x/crypto, x/net and x/text move as ONE MR, so one build proves the set.

GRADUATED — minor+patch (promoted by the graduation tick / Windmill f/desk/renovate_graduate). The baseline here is MR-only, so this list is the whole minor+patch automerge. Must sit above GRADUATED — major. `__none__` is a sentinel, not a package: it keeps an emptied list inert instead of matching everything.

GRADUATED — digest. Automerge a DIGEST update (same tag, rebuilt content) for the packages named here, written by the `automerge:digest` tick or label. ⚠️ PLACEMENT IS THE MECHANISM: must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR', whose matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules above it.

⛔ DEMOTED — MR-only whatever else says otherwise. Written by the `automerge:never` tick or label, which ALSO removes the package from every GRADUATED rule — the removal is what makes it bite, since GRADUATED·minor and ·major sit below this rule. ⚠️ Must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR': a demoted digest admitted to the shared branch would hold it open for every member.

DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR — every digest update that automerges shares one branch. matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules ABOVE, which keeps MR-only digests out: a group automerges only if every member does. Must stay below every rule that sets automerge for a digest.

GRADUATED — major. Packages explicitly promoted to MAJOR automerge by the graduation tick or the automerge:major label. A major is a breaking change by definition, so only packages named here automerge one. MUST stay last: packageRules are last-match-wins, and un-graduation is a removal from these lists.
